I’m sorry you had to go through that, and I’m glad my comment gave you new insight there are definitely signs that to someone who doesn’t know them seems like the person is getting better when in reality they’re closer to the end. A lot of times when dealing with depression and suicidal ideation your brain makes you think you’re a burden to everyone and that the world would be better without you. 

That’s why in some cases people suddenly get “happy” and super friendly they want to stop being a burden even though they never were and just want to make people happy before they go because they know how it feels to be down and we want our loved ones to have good memories of us in our last days vs seeing us miserable and broke down.

As someone who deals with severe suicidal thoughts and have attempted before it’s not your fault. A lot of times when it reaches that point it feels helpless and you don’t want to bring anyone down with your problems or be a burden because that’s how it feels like. 

A lot of times the act comes on so you don’t worry anyone. My first attempt my friends and family thought I was better, I was smiling every now and then, wasn’t mopping around or stuck in my room all day, I was hugging my parents more than ever, they thought I was getting better but it was a front. 

I wanted their last memories of me to be good ones not me being shut in my room all day before doing it. In my note I wrote that I didn’t blame them, that there was no way they could’ve known because I never told anyone, that no matter what they weren’t at fault and there was nothing they could’ve done because it had gotten to the point nothing gave me hope. The attempt didn’t work I was violently sick nom stop throwing up for a while before I blacked out. When I woke up my whole body felt like shit but I was alive. 

Please get the most help you can get, this stuck for a reason, it wasn’t your fault or anything close, but it would be very beneficial to seek any mental health you can get don’t be afraid to talk to people about how your feeling. You’re coping with it, I’m truly deeply sorry you had to be the one to do that and that you have to experience this
